lines.beaver: 어서 오세요! 오늘 김장 도와주셔서 고마워요.
lines.beaver_en: Come in! Thanks for helping with the kimjang today.
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo oseyo! oneul gimjang dowajusyeoseo gomawoyo.
lines.learner: 별말씀을요. 배추는 집에서 다 절여 왔어요.
lines.en: Not at all. I salted all the cabbage at home.
lines.roman: byeolmalsseumeullyo. baechuneun jibeseo da jeoryeo wasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 벌써요? 그럼 속 재료를 준비해 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Already? Then shall we prepare the filling?
lines.beaver_roman: beolsseoyo? geureom sok jaeryoreul junbihae bolkkayo?
lines.en: Yes, I bought fresh oysters and jujubes.

lines.beaver_en: Jujubes too? Do you add other ingredients?
lines.en: Adding a few clams makes it taste refreshing.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. What do we do with the clam shells?
lines.en: I'll shell them and add just the meat.

lines.beaver_en: How should I cut the radish? Julienne it?
lines.learner: 반은 채 썰고, 반은 토막 내서 넣어요.
lines.en: Julienne half, and cut half into chunks.
lines.roman: baneun chae sseolgo, baneun tomang naeseo neoeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How should we set the table for lunch?
lines.en: I'm thinking of braised beef short ribs for lunch.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, sounds delicious. How will you make it?
lines.learner: 대추를 넣으면 단맛이 나요. 미역국도 끓일게요.
lines.en: Jujubes make it sweet. I'll make seaweed soup too.
lines.roman: daechureul neoeumyeon danmasi nayo. miyeokgukdo kkeurilkkeyo.

lines.beaver_en: It'd be nice to have a fish dish too.
lines.en: I'll make pancakes with canned tuna.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, I heard oysters are good for you?
lines.en: Yes, as you know, they have lots of good nutrients.

lines.beaver: 오늘 정말 고마워요. 이제 시작해 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Thanks so much today. Shall we get started?
lines.beaver_roman: oneul jeongmal gomawoyo. ije sijakae bolkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 분명 맛있는 김장이 될 거예요!
lines.en: Yes, it's sure to be a tasty kimjang!
lines.roman: ne, bunmyeong masinneun gimjangi doel geoyeyo!
